one_line: Rashtrakuta king who seized the Deccan and proclaimed renewed kingship through the Hiranyagarbha ritual.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, medium height, athletic but not bulky, with the poised bearing of a seasoned field commander turned king.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, a neatly trimmed moustache, and a calm, focused default expression that reads as thoughtful and firm rather than harsh.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted in the center and drawn back into a single high knot at the back of the head, wrapped with a narrow gold headband and a maroon cloth strip, leaving a few short, controlled strands near the temples; no crown, emphasizing a warrior-prince rather than a fully bejewelled emperor.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-8th century Deccan royal-warrior attire: an ankle-length, off-white cotton dhoti with a narrow maroon border, pleated neatly in front and wrapped securely around the waist; over the torso a fitted, sleeveless, dark indigo cotton angarkha-style vest that reaches just below the hips, tied at the right side with visible cloth ties; across his chest a diagonal golden-yellow sash (uttariya) of fine, slightly patterned silk, its loose end draped over the left shoulder and hanging behind; under the vest a simple, close-fitting off-white inner tunic with short sleeves so the shoulders are modestly covered; on his forearms a pair of plain bronze bracers; around his waist a broad, deep-red cloth belt with a subtle woven pattern, from which a small utility pouch hangs at his right; jewellery kept dignified and restrained—medium-sized circular gold earrings, a single sturdy gold neck chain resting just above the collarbone, and one plain gold ring on his left hand; his feet are in dark brown leather sandals with a toe-strap and ankle strap, practical for both court and campaign.
appearance.signature: A single-edged Deccan sword (early talwar-like form) with a slightly curving steel blade, a simple steel crossguard, and a hilt bound in dark brown leather, worn at his left hip in a plain, dark wooden scabbard with minimal brass fittings; he usually rests his right hand lightly on the hilt, treating it as both a commander’s weapon and a symbol of his control over new military and agrarian networks.

ref_desc: Dantidurga is a medium-built Deccan king with a neat moustache, black hair in a high knot wrapped by a gold band and maroon strip, wearing an off-white dhoti, dark indigo sleeveless vest, golden-yellow sash, restrained gold jewellery, and a slightly curving Deccan sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Dantidurga as a dignified 8th‑century Deccan king: medium-built, medium-brown complexion, oval face, sharp dark eyes, calm firm expression, and a neatly trimmed moustache. His thick black hair is parted in the center and pulled into a single high knot at the back of his head, wrapped with a narrow gold headband and a maroon cloth strip, with a few short strands left by the temples. Dress him in an ankle-length off-white cotton dhoti with a narrow maroon border, pleated in front and wrapped securely; on his torso a fitted, sleeveless dark indigo cotton angarkha-style vest reaching just below the hips, tied on the right, worn over a simple off-white short-sleeved inner tunic so his shoulders remain modestly covered. Add a diagonal golden-yellow silk sash crossing his chest from right shoulder to left waist, its loose end draped over his left shoulder and hanging behind, suggesting both ritual prestige and political authority. Give him a broad deep-red patterned cloth belt around his waist with a small pouch at his right, plain bronze bracers on his forearms, medium circular gold earrings, a single sturdy gold neck chain, and one gold ring on his left hand. On his feet place dark brown leather sandals with toe and ankle straps. His signature weapon is a slightly curving single-edged Deccan sword with a simple steel crossguard and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, worn in a plain dark wooden scabbard with modest brass fittings at his left hip; pose him so his right hand rests lightly on the hilt as a calm commander. Emphasize the fixed combination of hair knot with gold and maroon wraps, off-white dhoti, dark indigo vest, golden-yellow sash, restrained gold jewellery, and the curved sword, shown from multiple angles to capture consistent anime-style proportions and colours.
